notes: Operator ruling (inbox 2026-11-26): the format declares `type`'s documented default and the guard reads the field as the runtime does — no amendment to guard semantics (contract.md 'clause': a truly absent guarded field stays silent). Default cited at McpServer in builtins.ts (code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp, retrieved 2026-07-15). Built-in-internal is enough; a new author-facing default surface is a question, not this entry.
